cc:Work.dc:title: GPU sharing throughput: fixed-cache test
cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed 6 GiB KV cache per instance, concurrency 8 per GPU; bars show the three-trial mean and error bars show +/-1 sample standard deviation. {"controlled": [{"configuration": "Native single", "mean": 628.5734074992245, "mode": "Graph", "sample_std": 0.3028659786669097}, {"configuration": "Native pair", "mean": 335.51471481403746, "mode": "Graph", "sample_std": 0.016527453865742385}, {"configuration": "HAMi pair (50%)", "mean": 335.8700276309079, "mode": "Graph", "sample_std": 0.06102868739071649}, {"configuration": "Legacy MPS pair", "mean": 449.3644088436405, "mode": "Graph", "sample_std": 13.92330162770467}, {"configuration": "Native single", "mean": 193.9521315751877, "mode": "Eager", "sample_std": 1.1650264400143422}, {"configuration": "Native pair", "mean": 185.79990440666973, "mode": "Eager", "sample_std": 0.7304753714014768}, {"configuration": "HAMi pair (50%)", "mean": 181.6723971498676, "mode": "Eager", "sample_std": 1.3212107530610666}, {"configuration": "Legacy MPS pair", "mean": 188.5074978107481, "mode": "Eager", "sample_std": 0.727842113958427}], "source_sha256": {"controlled.csv": "17e984ac98849ee5611013a33e9123efb0ae0a7ee9412c5004f5e5ba217c51ac"}}
